title: Complete implementation
adaptationNote: The unchanged shared course_test.hpp from Book II B02-L0110 is placed first; the local include is removed. CHECK stays active in optimized builds.

guide.problem: Find a value or insertion boundary without off-by-one errors.
guide.design: A half-open binary-search interval shrinks on every step. Linear search is sufficient for small or unsorted data.
guide.invariant: 0 <= low <= high <= size; the insertion point remains between the boundaries.
guide.failure: Using low=mid on a smaller middle value can stop progress. Returning any duplicate differs from returning the first.
guide.trace: For [1,3,3,7] and target 3, the first valid index is 1, not 2.
guide.maintenance: Record sortedness as a precondition and test empty, absent, and repeated targets.
guide.scope: This panel connects this listing to its chapter’s problem. Short demonstrations illustrate one part; the chapter’s complete implementation and invariant labs test the broader contract.

experiment: Predict one boundary or tie case, then change this listing and trace the affected state. For [1,3,3,7] and target 3, the first valid index is 1, not 2.
